definitions.cross_role: At least two nonempty roles among train,val,test,selk_holdout in the same fold; buffer_excluded is separately counted
definitions.grid: 64 by 64 center samples in each nominal 45 km AEQD footprint; center coordinates as saved to six decimals
definitions.limits: No new label/SAR mask, geometry repair, crater-name assignment to entire units, split changes, model outcomes or independence claims
definitions.longitude: Direct label lookup wraps to 0..360; source vector predicates wrap to -180..180
definitions.part_identity: zero-based order within the one original Craters MultiPolygon, bound to constituent file hashes; parts are not independent craters
definitions.sample_centers_by_source_part: Class-5 nearest-neighbor label sample centers covered by an original source polygon part
definitions.selection: All saved catalog IDs whose class-5 count is positive in the full 41138-center oracle; independent of modal class or role
definitions.source_pixel_intersections_by_part: Original source parts intersecting the source raster pixel for each class-5 sample; conservative all_touched support, including boundary-only contact
definitions.sphere_note: Angular positions compared directly; no terrestrial datum transformation or reinterpretation of EPSG:4326 as Earth geometry
